text:
Maria: heads-up — i'm prepping the SLO onboarding that surfaces alert thresholds in Console. thinking we should gate the rollout on fresh telemetry coverage so new tenants don't flood pager with bad baselines. any objections?

TJ: totally agree. main risk is sample bias — early traffic for some tenants is tiny and will make the default thresholds look strict. we should use a min-sample cutoff + synthetic warmup. :thinking_face:

Alex: fyi i sketched a small config for the gating logic: 
```
onboarding_gating:
  min_events: 1000
  window: 7d
  canary_pct: 5
  fallback_threshold: p95_latency * 1.25
```
If we hit min_events we enable real thresholds, otherwise we use fallback and flag for manual review.

Priya: UX note — Console needs to show why a tenant is still on "fallback" thresholds. users kept DMing SRE last time. we can add a badge: "Insufficient telemetry (0/1000 events)" and a CTA to simulate traffic or upload eval set.

TJ: +1 on CTA. also we should align quota checks: if tenant is on low plan we shouldn't enable noisy SLO alerts until they opt-in. otherwise ops gets paged for small customers.

Maria: good catch. proposal: couple the gating to two checks: telemetry coverage (min_events) AND tenant_quota >= standard. both must pass.

Alex: implementation detail — routing policy needs to tie into notify tiers. when fallback thresholds are active, route to "observe-only" channel (no pager) and mark violations as regressions not incidents. then promote after gate passes.

Priya: can we make the promotion atomic in Console? i.e., one click flips thresholds and fanout rules. need to avoid leaving half-configured state.

SRE Bot: deploy-notify: Canary rollout started for slo-onboard-gate v1 -> 5% of tenants. Progress updates in #deploys.

Zack: data retention Q — if we use a 7d window but tenant has intermittent bursts, promotion might oscillate. suggest smoothing: require window pass + 3 consecutive windows or apply EWMA to event count.

TJ: yep EWMA or hysteresis would help. also add a cooldown after demotion to avoid flapping.

Maria: ok actions: Alex to PR gating logic + API contract for Console toggle, Priya to mock the CTA/badge copy, TJ and Zack to propose hysteresis/cooldown params. i'll coordinate canary and runbook. thanks folks :thumbsup:
